content:
This instance carries every character class issue001 demonstrated corrupting or crashing the eval path: dollar signs, hashes, at-signs, angle brackets, asterisks. Emphasis works: *italic* and **bold**, a [link](https://example.com), and a literal star \*escaped\*.

- list item one
- list item two

requirements.statement: The unit price shall not exceed $500 per assembly, and totals like $1,234.56 shall render verbatim.
requirements.rationale: Dollar signs crashed the eval path with *unclosed delimiter*; this asserts the literal survives.

requirements.statement: Position reports @10Hz shall include payloads #1 through #4 in every frame.
requirements.notes: The `@` and `#` classes: eval swallowed hashes silently and crashed on at-references.

requirements.statement: Latency shall stay under <200ms> at P99, and markup-like text such as <config> or *emphasis* shall render as typed.
requirements.rationale: The silently-deleted-bound case: eval rendered this statement WITHOUT its performance bound.

requirements.statement: Injected directives such as #read("/brand/style-tokens.json") shall appear as literal text, never execute.
